content.text:
Option 1 needs changes in **cv/pit**, plus a small optional change in pi-action. Nothing in pi-durable is missing: its tool results can already carry images to the model, but pit's durable tool never puts them there. I looked at the installed pit v0.35.1 (`src/durable/*`) and `@earendil-works/pi-durable` 1.5.2, and haven't changed or committed anything.

## Why `viewImage` fails today

1. **pit turns it off on purpose.** `src/durable/host.ts` replaces the image collector with a stub whose `view()` always throws. The comment there says *"pi-durable has no image reader for Pit to reuse"*. The normal `viewImage` borrows a reader from `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent`, which isn't installed on a pi-durable host.
2. **The result never includes images.** `src/durable/tool.ts` passes `imageMetadata: []` and returns only the text blocks. pi-durable's `ToolExecutionResult.output` is `ToolResultMessage["content"]`, which accepts `ImageContent`, so the host side is fine.
3. **Images from `tools.read` are lost too.** pi-durable's `read` declares a `structuredOutputSchema`. Because of that, `callDurableTool` (`src/durable/tools.ts`) returns the image early as plain data and never attaches it. That's why I got base64 text last time and no "not attached" note.

## Proposed fix

**In cv/pit:**
1. **Write a real durable image collector.** Read the bytes with the same limits as now (10 MiB source, 5 MiB encoded, 8 images and 16 MiB per call), detect the format from the file header, and encode to base64. Optionally resize with pi-durable's own image processor (`@earendil-works/pi-durable/images/node` → `createNodePhotonImages()`), passed in as a new `PitDurableOptions.images` option. The same collector would also make `images` work in `models.classify` and `models.generateImages`.
2. **Attach the images in `durable/tool.ts`**: take a snapshot of the attached images, pass their metadata to `buildToolResult`, and return `output: [...result.content, ...images]`, as the non-durable `tool/typescript.ts` already does.
3. **Attach images from nested tools** even when the tool declares an output schema, so `tools.read` on a PNG reaches the model.
4. **Update docs and tests**: drop `workspace.viewImage` from the "unavailable" sentence in the tool description and replace the stub tests.

**In pi-action (optional):** in `src/durable-extensions.ts`, pass an image processor in the options given to `factory.create(...)`. The same processor could go to `CodingTools`, so large screenshots get resized instead of rejected. The model also has to accept images; it does here, since the plain `read` showed me the image in the first run.

I can open this as an issue or a draft PR on cv/pit if you'd like.

## pit built-ins that aren't available on pi-durable hosts

These throw `PitDurableUnavailableError`:

| Built-in | Reason pit gives |
|---|---|
| `workspace.viewImage` | no image reader (above) |
| `session.getName` | "pi-durable conversations have no name" |
| `session.setName` | same |
| `session.compact` | "the host compacts the conversation" |
| `commands.list` (all of `commands.*`) | "the host has no slash commands" |
| `models.set` | "the host configures the conversation's model" |
| `models.listOfType` | falls through to an unavailable error |
| `models.classify` | the same, and it would need image loading |
| `models.generateImages` | the same, and it would need image loading |

Some built-ins work only partly:
- **`ui.confirm`, `ui.input`, `ui.select`** work only if the host provides dialogs. pi-action does when questions are answered on GitHub; otherwise they throw "UI is not available in this mode" and `context.get().hasUI` is `false`. `ui.notify` always works.
- **`models.current` and `models.list`** work, but every catalog model shows as `scoped: true` and `refreshErrors` is always empty.
- **`context.get()`** works, but `sessionFile` is always undefined because conversations live in the host's storage, not in a file.
- **Images returned by nested `tools.*` calls** aren't attached (item 3 above).

Everything else works as on Pi: the rest of `workspace.*`, `git`, `npm`, `gh`, `shell`, `http`, `session.outline`, `inspectEntry`, `elide`, `summarize`, `setNote`, `notes`, `info`, `runtime.*` and `functions.*`.
